content.text: RF: age, DM, HTN, hyperlipidemia, smoking
(distal to occlusion worse w exertion & relieved by rest)
➀ buttock/thigh claudication ➁ ED ➂ ⇣ femoral pulses
▪︎atrophic skin Δ: shiny/taut, hairless skin; brittle nails, cool limbs, muscle atrophy
, tips of toes, base of heel, b/n digits;
▪︎gray-black discoloration w clear demarcation b/n necrotic & viable tissue
▪︎edema, blistering, d/c, moist appearance, rapid spread of infection
Persistent claudication w/ first line TX
